papers.title: MATE: Policy-Aware Security Auditing for Mobile Agents via Synthesis-Driven Trajectory Learning
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 foundation model 把智能体轨迹与自然语言安全策略一并编码，审计手机 agent 是否违反 App 策略，对象是 Android / 移动应用。
papers.abstract: 由基础模型驱动的手机 agent 已经能在真实设备上自动完成复杂的多步工作流，但它们的轨迹可能违反应用特有的安全策略。现有轨迹级防御依赖大语言模型提示或僵硬规则，难以支持细粒度、可跨应用和任务泛化的自然语言策略。本文提出 MATE，一个轻量、以策略为条件的审计器。它同时编码 agent 轨迹和自然语言安全策略，判断轨迹是否违反给定策略，并解释原因。把策略当成可编辑文本而不是固定模型参数，使 MATE 能处理用户自定义和不断变化的要求，而不必重新训练。为构造 MATE，我们从全球数百个流行手机应用中抽取应用描述、工作流和策略，建成知识库，并用多阶段流水线合成超过 14 万条语义上真实、带策略条件的轨迹。我们还发布 MATEBench，一个轨迹级审计基准，含两个合成子集和一个人工收集的真实子集。用我们的合成轨迹学习训练的模型在 MATEBench 上准确率超过 95%，在外部安全基准上仍然表现稳定，并在真实设备上审计智谱 AutoGLM 和阿里 Mobile-Agent 的轨迹，准确率超过 95%，比先前方法高 20% 以上。MATE 说明，对异构手机 agent 做实用的细粒度安全审计是可行且有效的。
papers.abstractEn: Mobile agents powered by foundation models now automate complex, multi-step workflows on real devices, but their trajectories can violate app-specific security policies. Existing trajectory-level defenses rely on LLM prompting or rigid rules, and thus fail to support fine-grained, natural-language policies that generalize across apps and tasks. In this work, we introduce MATE, a lightweight, policy-conditioned auditor that encodes both agent trajectories and natural-language security policies to determine whether a trajectory violates a given policy and to explain why. Treating policies as editable text rather than fixed model parameters allows MATE to handle user-defined and evolving requirements without retraining. To construct MATE, we build a knowledge base by extracting app descriptions, workflows, and policies from hundreds of popular mobile apps worldwide, and synthesizing over 140K semantically realistic, policy-conditioned trajectories with a multi-stage pipeline. We further release MATEBench, a trajectory-level auditing benchmark with two synthetic subsets and one real-world subset of manually collected trajectories. Models trained with our synthesis-driven trajectory learning achieve over 95% accuracy on MATEBench, retain strong performance on external safety benchmarks, and audit trajectories from Zhipu's AutoGLM and Alibaba's Mobile-Agent on real devices with over 95% accuracy, outperforming prior methods by over 20%. MATE shows that practical, fine-grained security auditing for heterogeneous mobile agents is both feasible and effective.

papers.title: State-Aware Fuzzing of JavaScript Engines with LLM-Guided Instrumentation
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 LLM agent 发现 JS 引擎深层内部状态并指导插桩，突破覆盖率平台期以找引擎漏洞，对象是 JavaScript 运行时。
papers.abstract: 现代 Web 的安全取决于 JavaScript 引擎是否正确，而这些复杂系统仍会被高影响缺陷击中。现有模糊器的关键限制是覆盖率平台期：控制流图饱和之后，边覆盖就不再能指导发现。JIT 优化层级、隐藏类转换等复杂行为常常共享同一条边覆盖，标准覆盖指标看不见触发深层错误所需的不同内部状态。为此我们提出 StateLens，用大语言模型自动发现深层内部状态。在所有状态上盲目插桩不可行，状态空间太大，运行时开销也高。StateLens 用一套模拟安全研究员直觉的 agent 推理流程：反复阅读代码和开发者注释，挑出高价值的插桩目标，把真正驱动逻辑的状态变量和无关数据分开。由此得到可合成、信号强的反馈探针，用来刻画引擎的隐藏配置。这些插桩进入双反馈机制，把模糊器导向尚未探索的引擎语义。评估表明 StateLens 明显优于现有模糊器，并发现 68 个新缺陷。
papers.abstractEn: The security of the modern web depends on the correctness of JavaScript (JS) engines, yet these complex systems remain vulnerable to high-impact bugs. A critical limitation of state-of-the-art fuzzers is the coverage plateau: once a fuzzer saturates the control-flow graph, edge coverage loses its ability to guide discovery. Because complex engine behaviors, such as JIT optimization tiers and hidden class transitions, often share identical edge coverage, standard coverage metrics are blind to the distinct internal states required to trigger deep errors. To bridge this gap, we present StateLens, a framework that employs Large Language Models (LLM) to automate the discovery of deep internal states. Blindly placing instrumentation probes at all states is infeasible due to the vast state space and the high runtime overhead. StateLens introduces a novel agent-based reasoning pipeline that emulates the intuition of a security researcher. By iteratively traversing code and developer comments, our agents intelligently select high-value instrumentation targets, effectively separating logic-driving state variables from irrelevant data. This results in synthesizable, high-signal feedback probes that map the engine's hidden configurations. This instrumentation feeds a dual-feedback mechanism, effectively guiding the fuzzer toward unexplored engine semantics. Our evaluation confirms that StateLens significantly outperforms state-of-the-art fuzzers and uncovering 68 new bugs.

papers.title: SyzHarness: Patch-Based Kernel Bug Reproduction with LLM-Synthesized Fuzzing Harnesses
papers.abstractOneWord: 结合 LLM agent 与覆盖率导向 fuzz，从补丁合成参数化 harness 以复现 Linux 内核漏洞。
papers.abstract: 自动复现内核漏洞对分拣、补丁验证和回归测试都很必要，但仍然缺少既有效又高效的办法。核心困难有两层：复现程序先要恢复到达漏洞状态所需的触发骨架，再确定真正触发缺陷的具体取值。现有定向模糊测试不擅长恢复触发骨架，而只靠大语言模型生成又很脆，因为它不擅长发现具体取值，也对付不了运行时的非确定性。我们设计了 SyzHarness，把大语言模型推理和覆盖率导向的模糊测试结合起来，基于补丁复现 Linux 内核漏洞。给定补丁，SyzHarness 用能浏览代码的 LLM agent 合成一个参数化的模糊 harness：把前置设置逻辑固定下来，只把不确定、对缺陷关键的输入参数暴露给 Syzkaller 去变异。然后把它翻译成 Syzkaller 兼容接口，并用分层可达性反馈迭代改进。我们在多组可触发的真实 Linux 内核漏洞上评估。在 100 个 KernelCTF 案例上，复现成功率为 78%。在 SyzDirect 基准上为 73%，明显超过先前的定向灰盒模糊测试。在 2026 年 3 月之后修复的 50 个已知可触发的 syzbot 缺陷上，只拿修复提交作为输入，SyzHarness 复现了 40/50（80%）。
papers.abstractEn: Automated kernel vulnerability reproduction is essential for bug triage, patch validation, and regression testing, but still lacks an effective and efficient solution. The core challenge is twofold: a reproducer must first recover the trigger scaffold needed to reach the vulnerable state and determine the precise concrete values that actually trigger the bug. Existing directed fuzzing approaches are ineffective at recovering the necessary trigger scaffold, while LLM- only generation is brittle because it struggles with concrete-value discovery and runtime nondeterminism. We design SyzHarness, a framework that combines LLM reasoning with coverage-guided fuzzing for patch-based Linux kernel vulnerability reproduction. Given a patch, SyzHarness uses an LLM agent grounded by code navigation tools to synthesize a parameterized fuzzing harness that fixes the prerequisite setup logic while exposing only uncertain, bug- critical input parameters to be mutated by Syzkaller. SyzHarness then translates this harness into a Syzkaller- compatible interface and iteratively refines it using hierarchical reachability feedback. We evaluate SyzHarness on multiple datasets of triggerable real-world Linux kernel vulnerabilities. On 100 KernelCTF cases, SyzHarness achieves a 78% bug reproduction success rate. On the SyzDirect benchmark, SyzHarness achieves a 73% bug reproduction success rate, substantially outperforming prior directed greybox fuzzing. On 50 recent, known-triggerable syzbot bugs fixed after March 2026, SyzHarness reproduces 40/50 (80%) using only the fix commits as input.

papers.title: MobileCybench: Evaluating Agent Vulnerability Discovery via Executable Probes
papers.abstractOneWord: 用可执行 probe 回放并核验编码 agent 的漏洞报告，在 13 款 Android 应用上评估 agent 漏洞发现能力。
papers.abstract: AI agent 报告漏洞的速度已经超过维护者审阅的速度。报告往往依赖应用特有的安全性质，处理起来很费人工。为此我们引入用探针评估漏洞报告的框架：探针是对安全性质的可执行检查。报告中的利用会被回放到应用上并运行探针；探针触发既说明利用成功，也说明它违反了哪条安全性质。探针编码的是安全性质而不是某个已知漏洞，因此也能发现写探针时还不知道的漏洞。我们把该框架实现为 MobileCybench，用来评测 AI agent 在 13 个 Android 应用上的漏洞发现，其中 495 个探针由作者编写并审阅。我们评估 5 个编码 agent（OpenCode 配 GPT-5.5、GPT-5.6-Sol 和 GLM-5.2；Claude Code 配 Opus 4.8 和 Opus 5），设置有四种：作为受害者设备上的恶意应用，或作为只有低权限账户的远程攻击者；每种要么只有混淆后的 APK，要么还能看到源码。只给混淆 APK 时，最好的 OpenCode + GPT-5.6-Sol 在恶意应用设置下触发了 53.8% 应用的探针，在远程攻击者设置下为 16.7%。有源码时，所有 agent 和两种攻击设置的触发率从 28.8% 升到 32.8%。构建并运行该基准还暴露了 23 个此前未报告的漏洞，其中大多数已由维护者确认。
papers.abstractEn: AI agents now report vulnerabilities faster than maintainers can review them. Reports often depend on security properties specific to the application, and require considerable human labor to process. To mitigate this, we introduce a framework for evaluating vulnerability reports via probes, executable checks of security properties. A reported exploit is evaluated by replaying it against the application and running the probes: a triggered probe indicates both that the exploit succeeded and which security property it violated. As a probe encodes a security property rather than a known vulnerability, it can detect vulnerabilities that were not known when the probe was written. We instantiate the framework as MobileCybench, a benchmark for vulnerability discovery by AI agents in 13 Android applications, with 495 probes written and reviewed by the authors. We evaluate 5 coding agents (OpenCode with GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6-Sol, and GLM-5.2; Claude Code with Opus 4.8 and Opus 5) under 4 settings: as a malicious app on the victim's device or as a remote attacker with a low-privilege account, each with either only an obfuscated APK or access to the application's source code. Given only the obfuscated APK, the top agent, OpenCode with GPT-5.6-Sol, triggers probes in 53.8% of applications in the malicious-app setting and 16.7% in the remote-attacker setting. With source code, the trigger rate across all agents and both attack settings increases from 28.8% to 32.8%. Building and running the benchmark surfaced 23 previously unreported vulnerabilities, the majority of which have been confirmed by maintainers.

papers.title: SelfOp: An Optimization Algorithm for Self-Improving Security Agents
papers.abstractOneWord: 在不改模型权重的情况下，用文本梯度优化安全 agent 的任务上下文，用于漏洞发现、利用复现与补丁生成。
papers.abstract: 大语言模型 agent 越来越多地用于漏洞发现、利用复现和补丁生成。在模型层面改进它们需要专家演示或可计算的奖励，而安全任务很少能提供：轨迹昂贵，失败难以诊断，奖励稀疏且不可计算。于是工作转向 harness 和上下文，但手工调参需要任务专门知识且难以扩展；自动化方法又依赖稀缺的真值、更强的优化模型，或无引导的“提议再评估”循环，最后变成昂贵的试错。我们提出 SelfOp，在不改执行 harness 和模型权重的情况下，自动改进一个冻结的安全 agent 的任务上下文（指令、技能和参考文档）。SelfOp 把上下文优化看成受链式法则启发的文本梯度下降：从单个实例的结果出发，把误差信号经评估器、agent 轨迹和塑造其行为的上下文工件反向传播，得到每个实例的文本梯度。梯度跨实例通过聚类、排序和过滤累积，只在跨实例达成共识时提交。收敛检测器盯着梯度信号本身，一旦上下文吸收了训练数据里可泛化的信息就停止，不需要留出验证集。我们在真实漏洞复现基准 CyberGym 上评估。不到 200 个训练样本时，SelfOp 让 GPT-5.4-mini（配 Codex）自我提升 17 分，超过前沿的 GPT-5.4 基线 6 分，并让 GPT-5.4 本身提升 18.5 分。优化后的技能还能跨模型迁移，说明学到的是可泛化的任务知识，而不是某个模型的特殊模式。
papers.abstractEn: LLM agents are increasingly used for security tasks: vulnerability discovery, exploit reproduction, and patch generation. Improving them at the model level demands expert demonstrations or computable rewards, which security tasks rarely offer: traces are costly, failures hard to diagnose, rewards sparse, and non-computable. Efforts thus shift to the harness and context, but manual tuning needs task-specific expertise and scales poorly, while automated methods rely on scarce ground truth, stronger optimizer models, or unguided propose-and-evaluate loops that reduce to costly trial and error. We introduce SelfOp, an algorithm that automatically improves a frozen security agent's task context (instructions, skills, and reference documents), without modifying its execution harness and model weights. SelfOp casts context optimization as chain-rule-inspired textual gradient descent: from a single instance's outcome, it propagates error signals backward through the evaluator, the agent's trajectory, and the context artifacts that shaped its behavior, yielding per-instance textual gradients. Gradients are accumulated across instances by clustering, ranking, and filtering, and committed only under cross-instance consensus. A convergence detector monitors the gradient signal itself and stops once the context has absorbed the generalizable information in the training data, without held-out validation data. We evaluate SelfOp on CyberGym, a benchmark of real-world vulnerability reproduction tasks. With fewer than 200 training examples, SelfOp yields a 17-point self-improvement for GPT-5.4-mini (with Codex), enough to surpass the frontier GPT-5.4 baseline by 6 points, and an 18.5-point self-improvement for GPT-5.4 itself. The optimized skills also transfer across models, highlighting that SelfOp-optimized skills learn generalizable task knowledge not model-specific patterns.

papers.title: VSpector: Specification-Driven Bug Detection for RISC-V CPUs
papers.abstractOneWord: 用 LLM 从 RISC-V 自然语言规范逐步核对 RTL 实现，检测开源 CPU 设计漏洞。
papers.abstract: 在开源 RISC-V CPU 实现里找出 RTL 设计缺陷，对系统可靠性很重要。传统检测依赖预先准备好的工件。本文把官方自然语言 RISC-V 规范当作缺陷检测的信息来源，提出 VSpector：一条由规范驱动的检测流水线，直接检查 CPU 寄存器传输级（RTL）实现是否遵守官方规范规则，而不必专门构造参考模型、形式化性质或自定义缺陷模式。为了处理大语言模型在“上下文要广”和“推理要准”之间的矛盾，VSpector 用逐步收窄上下文的四阶段流水线：抽取规则、定位实现、找出候选、按顺序审计违规。我们在两款工业级 RISC-V CPU（CVA6 与香山）上评估。217 个报告候选中，人工确认 148 个真实违规，精确率 68.2%。这些违规对应 73 个不同缺陷，其中 42 个此前未知。对比实验里，先进的 CPU 模糊器 DiveFuzz 在每款 CPU 上跑 24 小时，一个新缺陷都没找到。42 个新缺陷已报告上游，开发者已修复 19 个并再确认 11 个（合计 30 个）。说明用规范做审计，是检测 CPU 缺陷的一种可行、互补的办法。
papers.abstractEn: Detecting RTL design bugs in open-source RISC-V CPU implementations is critical for ensuring system reliability. Traditional detection approaches inherently rely on predefined artifacts. In this paper, we leverage the official,natural-language RISC-V specifications as an effective information source for bug detection. We present VSpector, a specification-driven bug detection pipeline that directly checks whether CPU register-transfer level (RTL) implementations adhere to official specification rules, without requiring specialized construction of reference models, formal properties, or custom bug patterns. To resolve the key technical trade-off between broad context scope and model reasoning accuracy when using Large Language Models (LLMs), VSpector employs a stepwise context refinement scheme across a four-stage pipeline: rule extraction, implementation localization, candidate identification, and sequential violation auditing. We evaluate VSpector on two industrial-strength RISC-V CPUs, CVA6 and XiangShan. Out of 217 reported candidates, manual inspection confirmed 148 true violations, representing a 68.2% precision. These violations correspond to 73 distinct bugs, including 42 previously unknown bugs. In our comparative experiments, DiveFuzz, a state-of-the-art CPU fuzzer, detected none of these new bugs during 24-hour runs per CPU. All 42 new bugs have been reported upstream, with developers already fixing 19 and confirming an additional 11 (30 in total), demonstrating that specification-driven auditing is a practical and complementary strategy for CPU bug detection.

papers.title: The Anatomy of Address Poisoning on Ethereum: Funding Mechanisms, Scam Signatures, and Laundering via Tornado Cash
papers.abstractOneWord: 剖析以太坊地址投毒钓鱼的资金来源、骗局签名与 Tornado Cash 洗钱路径，无 LLM。
papers.abstract: 地址投毒转账（APT）是一种常见的区块链钓鱼：诈骗者生成一笔转账，其地址看起来很像受害者曾经交互过的正常地址，从而污染受害者的地址簿。手法简单，但近年来已让用户损失数百万美元，并引起研究社区关注（Ye 等人 WWW'24，Guan-Li CCS'24，Chen 等人 NDSS'25，Tsuchiya 等人 USENIX'25）。本文不停留在检测，而是考察 APT 三个重要但研究不足的方面：骗局资金从哪来、骗局有哪些签名、赃款如何经公共服务洗出。我们特别提出五类骗局签名，用来刻画 APT 操作的关键特征，并有助于地址聚类。我们也首次调查了用 Tornado Cash 为 APT 提供资金以及清洗赃款的情况。
papers.abstractEn: Address-Poisoning Transfer (APT) is a prevalent blockchain phishing scam in which a scammer poisons a victim's address book by generating a transfer with a phishing address that looks similar to a benign address that the victim has previously interacted with. Although simple, APT phishing attacks have cost users millions of dollars in recent years, which has captured the attention of the research community (Ye et al. WWW'24, Guan-Li CCS'24, Chen et al. NDSS'25, Tsuchiya et al. USENIX'25). In this work, we go beyond detection and investigate three important and underexplored aspects of APT: scam funding mechanisms, scam signatures, and scam proceeds laundering via public services. In particular, we propose five families of scam signatures that capture key aspects of APT operations, which are useful for address clustering. We also conduct the first investigation into usage of Tornado Cash for funding APTs and laundering scam proceeds.

papers.title: Schnorr Signatures and MuSig2 Are Jointly Secure, Even in Deterministic Wallets
papers.abstractOneWord: 证明 Schnorr 与 MuSig2 在确定性钱包重随机化组合下仍然安全，对象是加密货币钱包与多签。
papers.abstract: 现代加密货币钱包把 Schnorr 签名和公开的确定性密钥派生一起使用：反复重随机化一把主公钥，就可以在不接触秘密的情况下派生出任意多个用于收款的公钥。有些钱包还支持 MuSig2 这类多重签名，把 n 个不同参与方派生出的公钥可选地聚成 n-of-n 公钥，这样收到的资金只有在全部 n 方授权时才能花出。这些高级密钥管理把底层密码方案用到了现有安全证明没有覆盖的范围。确定性 Schnorr 钱包和 MuSig2 各自都被证明安全，但它们的组合尽管已经部署在钱包里，可证明安全性尚未建立。本文要缩小理论与实践之间的这一缺口。我们首次形式化分析了单签 Schnorr 与 MuSig2 在重随机化和确定性钱包中的联合使用。首先引入（可重随机化的）联合签名方案：诚实签名者用同一把秘密密钥既做单签也做多重签名。在该模型中，我们在代数群模型（AGM）与随机预言模型（ROM）的组合下，基于代数一次多离散对数（AOMDL）假设，证明 Schnorr 加 MuSig2 的紧安全。最后我们给出带联合签名的确定性钱包形式模型，并证明在公开的确定性密钥派生下，Schnorr 加 MuSig2 仍然安全。
papers.abstractEn: Modern cryptocurrency wallets use Schnorr signatures together with public, deterministic key derivation: by repeatedly rerandomizing a single master public key, an unlimited number of public keys for incoming payments can be derived without access to secret data. Moreover, some wallets support multi-signature schemes such as MuSig2 for optionally aggregating derived public keys from $n$ distinct parties into "$n$-of-$n$" public keys, so that funds received on such aggregated keys can be spent only when authorized by all $n$ parties. However, these advanced key-management techniques stretch the underlying cryptographic schemes beyond the guarantees provided by existing security proofs. Although deterministic Schnorr wallets and MuSig2 have each been proven secure in isolation, the provable security of their composition---despite its deployment in wallets---has not been established thus far. The goal of this work is to narrow this gap between theory and practice. We provide the first formal security analysis of the joint use of single-signer Schnorr signatures and MuSig2, both under rerandomization and in deterministic wallets. First, we introduce the notion of a (rerandomizable) joint-signature scheme, in which an honest signer uses the same secret key for single-signer signatures and multi-signatures. Within this model, we prove tight security of Schnorr signatures plus MuSig2 under the algebraic one-more discrete logarithm (AOMDL) assumption in the combination of the algebraic group model (AGM) and the random oracle model (ROM). Finally, we provide a formal model of deterministic wallets with joint-signature schemes and show that Schnorr plus MuSig2 remains secure under public, deterministic key derivation.

papers.title: Cryptanalysis of LDVR: Polynomial-Time Adaptive Attacks against Threshold Schnorr Signatures
papers.abstractOneWord: 对 LDVR 给出多项式时间自适应攻击，并可转化为对暴露份额公钥的门限 Schnorr 签名攻击。
papers.abstract: 我们给出针对低维向量表示（LDVR）问题某些参数的第一个多项式时间攻击。LDVR 由 Crites、Katz、Komlo、Tessaro 和 Zhu（CRYPTO '25）提出，用来在代数群模型中证明 FROST 的自适应安全。在 Crites 和 Stewart（CRYPTO '25）的工作之上，他们还证明：对 LDVR 的每一次攻击都会直接变成对一类门限 Schnorr 签名的自适应攻击，也就是利用自适应腐败的攻击。这类签名会向攻击者暴露 g^{sk_i}，其中 sk_i 是签名者持有的密钥份额，g 是底层群的生成元。这类协议包括 FROST（Komlo 和 Goldberg，SAC '20）、Sparkle（Crites、Komlo 和 Maller，CRYPTO '23）、Lindell 的三轮协议（CiC '24），以及其他无掩码协议。因此，我们的结果给出了针对一类实用门限签名的第一个多项式时间自适应攻击。攻击需要很多签名者，但数量仍是多项式的：渐近上需要 n = Θ(log² p) 个签名者，并腐败其中 t_c = Θ(log p) 个。对 Curve25519 的素数阶子群，具体且优化后的攻击需要 n = 5020 个签名者，并腐败其中 204 个。这超过了实践中常见的签名者数量，但仍落在 NIST 门限签名征集所考虑的场景里。理论上，这些结果也给出了一个基于真实多方协议的、非人为构造的静态安全与自适应安全分离。攻击来自一种新的归约：把 LDVR 归约到由用于秘密分享签名密钥的多项式求值点所决定的结构化子集和问题。我们进一步证明，若允许对手选择这些求值点，攻击可以高效得多。
papers.abstractEn: We present the first polynomial-time attacks against certain parameter choices of the low-dimensional vector representation (LDVR) problem, introduced by Crites, Katz, Komlo, Tessaro, and Zhu (CRYPTO '25) to prove the adaptive security of FROST in the Algebraic Group Model. Building on work by Crites and Stewart (CRYPTO '25), they also show that every attack against LDVR directly yields an adaptive attack—i.e., one leveraging adaptive corruptions—against any threshold Schnorr signature that exposes to the attacker the values $g^{\mathrm{sk}_i}$ for the secret-key shares $\mathrm{sk}_i$ held by the signers, where $g$ is a generator of the underlying group. This class of protocols includes FROST (Komlo and Goldberg, SAC '20), Sparkle (Crites, Komlo, and Maller, CRYPTO '23), Lindell's three-round protocol (CiC '24), along with other masking-free protocols. Consequently, our results give the first polynomial-time adaptive attacks against a class of practical threshold signatures. Our attacks require a large, but still polynomial, number of signers: asymptotically, we require $n = \Theta(\log^2 p)$ signers and corrupt $t_c = \Theta(\log p)$ of them. For the prime-order subgroup of Curve25519, concrete and optimized instantiations of our attack require $n=5020$ signers and corrupt $204$ of them. This exceeds the signer counts commonly encountered in practice, but falls within the scenarios considered by NIST's call for threshold signatures. At the theoretical level, our results also yield a non-artificial separation between static and adaptive security based on a real-world multi-party protocol. Our results arise from a new reduction from LDVR to structured subset-sum problems determined by the evaluation points of the polynomial used to secret-share the signing key. We further show that allowing these evaluation points to be chosen adversarially can lead to substantially more efficient attacks.

papers.title: Practical Adaptor Signatures for NP from Online/Offline NIZK
papers.abstractOneWord: 从 Online/Offline NIZK 构造面向任意 NP 关系的实用适配器签名，用于链上条件支付。
papers.abstract: 适配器签名让区块链上的条件支付成为可能：预签名绑定到一个公开实例 Y，任何知道见证 y 且 R(Y, y) = 1 的人都可以把它补成有效签名；预签名和完整签名合在一起又让签名者能抽出 y。现有构造只支持特定的代数结构关系，或者失去见证隐私，或者在签名大小和计算上开销很大。我们给出一个面向任意 NP 关系的实用适配器签名框架，它建立在一种新原语 Online/Offline NIZK 上，证明被分成在线和离线两部分。关键性质是：知道离线部分使用的随机数，就可以从在线部分抽出见证。我们给出两个通用构造：达到见证隐藏的基本方案，以及达到我们新引入的、更强的前向安全隐私的实例隐藏方案。我们用 VOLE-in-the-Head 和后量子签名 FAEST，把框架实例化到 AES-128 关系上。得到的完整签名为 11.6 kB，比面向 NP 的现有适配器签名（Ciampi 等人，CT-RSA '25）大约小 60%，实现在签名生成、验证和抽取上整体快一个数量级。
papers.abstractEn: Adaptor signatures enable conditional payments on blockchain networks: a pre-signature is bound to a public instance $Y$ and can be completed into a valid signature by any party knowing a witness $y$ with $\mathcal{R}(Y,y)=1$, while the pre-signature and full signature together allow the signer to extract $y$. Existing constructions only support specific algebraically-structured relations, lose witness privacy, or have significant overhead both in signature size and computation. We present a practical adaptor signature framework for arbitrary NP relations, built from a new primitive we call Online/Offline NIZK whose proof is separated into online and offline parts. The key property is that the witness can be extracted from the online part knowing the randomness used in the offline part. We give two generic constructions: a basic scheme achieving witness hiding, and an instance-hiding scheme achieving a new, stronger forward-secure privacy notion we introduce. We instantiate our framework for the AES-128 relation using the VOLE-in-the-Head paradigm and the FAEST post-quantum signature scheme. The resulting complete signature is $11.6$ kB, roughly $60\%$ smaller than the state-of-the-art adaptor signature for NP (Ciampi et al., CT-RSA '25), and our implementation is an order of magnitude faster in overall signature generation, verification, and extraction.

papers.title: Lattice-Based Synchronous Signatures: Efficiently Aggregatable and Thresholdizable
papers.abstractOneWord: 为 PoS 验证者签名构造可聚合、可门限化的格基同步签名，缩短多验证者区块签名。
papers.abstract: 聚合签名在权益证明系统里很重要，因为许多验证者要为一块签名。人们很希望把这些签名聚成一个短签名，并且验证要快。由于所有验证者都知道自己正在签的区块号，这个场景适合同步（也叫有状态）签名。Boneh 和 Kim（2019）证明基于格的一次性签名可以非常高效地聚合。Chipmunk 和 Lemur 用一棵包含 ℓ 个一次性公钥的（同态）Merkle 树，把它扩展成 ℓ 次同步方案。树的每片叶子签一条消息，这些一次性签名可以跨许多签名者聚合。由于 Merkle 树，每个聚合签名都要带一条长度为 O_λ(log ℓ) 的 Merkle 认证路径。我们给出另一种基于格的同步聚合签名。聚合签名的长度与 ℓ 无关，渐近上比现有方案更短，在某些参数下具体也更短。验证算法是代数的，因此适合高效的门限签名。我们还能在自适应腐败模型下证明安全。于是得到一种高效的基于格的同步门限签名：许多签名者的签名可以聚成一个短签名。该方案依赖一次可信建立来生成公共参数。
papers.abstractEn: Aggregate signatures play an important role in proof-of-stake systems, where many validators sign a block. There is a strong desire to aggregate all these signatures into one short signature that is fast to verify. Since all validators know the block number they are signing, this setting is well suited for synchronous (a.k.a stateful) signatures. Boneh and Kim (2019) showed that lattice-based one-time signatures (OTS) can be aggregated very efficiently. The Chipmunk and Lemur signature schemes extend this to an $\ell$-time synchronous scheme using a (homomorphic) Merkle tree of $\ell$ one-time public keys. Each leaf of the tree is used to sign one message, and these one-time signatures can be aggregated across many signers. Due to the Merkle tree, every aggregate signature includes a Merkle authentication path of length $O_\lambda(\log \ell)$. We present a different lattice-based approach to constructing a synchronous aggregate signature scheme. The length of an aggregate signature in our scheme is independent of $\ell$. The resulting signatures are asymptotically shorter than existing schemes, and concretely shorter for some parameter choices. The resulting signature verification algorithm is algebraic, which makes it amendable to efficient threshold signing. Moreover, we are able to prove security in an adaptive corruption model. We thus obtain an efficient lattice-based synchronous threshold signature scheme, where signatures from many signers can be aggregated into a single short signature. The scheme relies on a one time trusted setup to generate the public parameters.

papers.title: Cryptanalysis of a Polynomial-Based Redactable Blockchain
papers.abstractOneWord: 攻破基于多元多项式的可编辑区块链：未授权改写可归约为有限域求根再解线性方程组。
papers.abstract: 我们分析了一种最近发表的、基于多元多项式方程的可编辑区块链构造。我们证明，它的公开完整性条件暴露了足够的代数结构，可以高效恢复相关的私有求值点。因此，未授权改写区块链的问题归约为有限域上的一元求根，再解一个线性方程组。我们也讨论了一种基于线性化的替代攻击。
papers.abstractEn: We analyze a recently published construction of redactable blockchains based on multivariate polynomial equations. We show that its public integrity conditions reveal sufficient algebraic structure to recover the relevant private evaluation points efficiently. As a consequence, the blockchain unauthorized redaction problem reduces to univariate root finding over a finite field followed by solving a linear system. We also discuss an alternative attack based on linearization.
